class.name: VECSSnapshotReplication
class.brief_description: Default server-authoritative replication: dirty-checked deltas + periodic full-state reconciliation.
class.description: [b]VECSSnapshotReplication[/b] is the default [VECSSyncStrategy]. The server tracks which networked components are dirty, sends spawns/deltas/despawns, and periodically broadcasts a full state so clients can reconcile and remove ghosts. Entities with at least one networked component (the default) replicate automatically.

members.member: Seconds between periodic full-state broadcasts. Lower it for faster convergence at the cost of bandwidth.
